title: Hearty Spanish Fish Toast
description: Grassy, crisp, and energizing, this Spanish dish is perfect for a quick breakfast or brunch. Featuring turmeric-spiced fish on toasted bread, it's a pescatarian-friendly delight.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together turmeric, smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the preheated skillet and saut7e the cod fillets for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, toast the bread slices by placing them in the toaster or under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Once the fish is done, place the toasted bread slices on a plate and top each slice with a piece of fish, a sprinkle of turmeric-spiced mixture, and a drizzle of lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped parsley and crumbled feta cheese, if desired.
If desired, add crushed red pepper flakes for an extra kick of heat.
